Sky cubemap is captured at one fixed point per round, not a spatial radiance field
Source bound is atmosphere analytic envelope; not photometer calibration
Explicit initialize/refresh draws six faces synchronously; scheduled work is face-budgeted
No CPU/GPU timing or FPS claim

sourceBound.kernelBudgetPolicy: Float32 legacy8 or proven adaptive-index fallback; saturated taps outside only
sourceBound.method: 32x32 conservative source overlap bins; actual pixel-integrated Gaussian peak and projected shutter/stretch extent; near crossings cover viewport; legacy globalFiniteSurfaceCeiling is a spherical reference only; root separately budgets ambient/air/receivers

exposureState.convention: positive relative gainEV brightens; not absolute EV100
limits: Night/twilight ceiling is authored perceptual intent, not eye physiology or absolute photometric calibration.
A histogram is used only when a host supplies actual HDR pixels; no GPU metering is implied by a missing histogram.
Storage exposureP is a separate precision variable and must cancel before display.

clusters.illuminationModel: two launch-plane spatial moments from current head/tail RGB; not resolved area emission
two launch-plane spatial moments from current head/tail RGB; not resolved area emission

photometry.reference: 3.6 relative directional irradiance per100000 reference lux; effective, not measured
limits: Source bounds must cover all participating RGB channels and worst relevant overlap.
Finite FP16 storage and final display dynamic range are different constraints.
A changed storage exposure does not change photographic exposure.
